summary: Kullorsuaq Heliport (KHQ) is a remote helicopter facility serving the small Inuit settlement of Kullorsuaq in the Upernavik municipality of northwestern Greenland, near Melville Bay. As one of the most isolated communities in Greenland, the heliport is a vital lifeline for residents who rely on helicopter service for access to regional centers, medical care, and supplies, with no road connections or fixed-wing airstrip available.
